link.description: The users of the Elocity web application are primarily electric vehicle (EV) charging station operators, energy managers, and service personnel responsible for maintaining and monitoring EV infrastructure. These individuals interact with the platform to oversee charging station performance, track energy usage, and address any technical issues promptly. By leveraging the application's robust features and intuitive interface, users ensure seamless operation, maximize efficiency, and uphold a superior charging experience for customers, while aligning with broader sustainability and operational goals. To view all the users, navigate to Administration > User Management.
